meta.rotation: Weekly deals rotation: every price below was read from a live listing or deal roundup on the checked date. When a sale ends, the refresh drops or reprices the item — see STORE-CATALOG-REFRESH.md.
meta.pricing_rule: Bundle markup ladder on the combined sale total: 3 items +20%, 6 items +15%, 9 items +10% — always capped below the combined regular total (at least $2 under, never below the sale total).
